name: Unicode Escape / Unescape
summary: Escape text to JavaScript Unicode sequences or decode \u escapes back to characters.
description: Convert plain text into \uXXXX and \u{...} escapes, or unescape JavaScript-style sequences including \xNN and common short escapes like \n and \t.

faqs.question: Which escape formats are supported?
faqs.answer: \uXXXX for BMP characters, \u{1F680} for astral code points, \xNN bytes, and short escapes like \n and \t.

faqs.question: Does escape keep ASCII readable?
faqs.answer: By default only non-ASCII characters are escaped. Enable “Escape ASCII too” to encode every character.

faqs.question: Is this the same as HTML entities?
faqs.answer: No. Use HTML Entity Encode / Decode for & and numeric HTML entities.
